key_cost_findings: pcl_e2_back_deck plus pcl_e3_bay_mouth account for 39.32% of logged token volume in the selected window.
Those two cameras average about 10.8k tokens/request versus about 6.8k for the other four cameras.
Camera-level vision dominates cost; cross-camera synthesis is not the primary remaining lever.

signal_replay_pilot.method: Replayed canonical vision.json states from Git commit history; no new image-model/API calls.
signal_replay_pilot.result: Across 32 sampled canonical quiet-period vision states, no camera produced a unique positive Jubilee/biological/human signal relative to its same-site peers.
signal_replay_pilot.limitation: Quiet-snapshot agreement is not proof a camera is dispensable. Positive-event and precursor periods must be replayed before any suppression/deployment.
signal_replay_pilot.positive_event_challenge: Canonical vision.json commit queries returned zero snapshots for 2026-08-29 and 2026-08-30, so the known positive-event period cannot be used as a retrospective camera-suppression challenge from repository history.

normalize_e2_back_deck_and_e3_to_6818_to.assumption: Same request counts; only per-call token footprint falls to current E2 bay-mouth level.

half_frequency_e2_back_deck_and_e3.assumption: Outside critical windows only; not authorized for deployment and effectiveness not validated.

half_frequency_two_secondary_montrose_vi.assumption: Keep shoreline view full cadence; not authorized for deployment and positive-event sensitivity unvalidated.

normalize_expensive_point_clear_plus_hal.assumption: Illustrative combined upper bound before interaction effects; not a forecast of realized savings.

decisions: Do not turn off or reduce capture cadence for any of six cameras.
Do not change GPT vision cadence yet.
Prioritize offline historical marginal-value replay over known Jubilee/precursor periods.
Prioritize ROI/crop/resize testing for pcl_e2_back_deck and pcl_e3_bay_mouth because they are the highest token-cost views.
Any gating must preserve full dawn/critical-window analysis until retrospective sensitivity is demonstrated.
Do not deploy camera-frequency suppression until a positive/precursor challenge set exists; focus first on reducing per-call token footprint for expensive Point Clear views.
next_zero_cost_tests: Replay all available historical vision.json commits and score unique-signal/disagreement rates per camera.
When PointClearPC returns online, compute deterministic duplicate/brightness/motion/ROI-change features from already captured frames and test against existing GPT labels.
Prepare ROI-only candidate images for E2 back deck and E3 bay mouth and estimate pixel/token reduction offline; no paid comparison calls without explicit approval.
Use event/precursor days as mandatory false-negative challenge set before any production gating proposal.

validation.test_scope: signal classification, same-site unique signal, usage join
